extracted.name: Halloumi & beetroot fritters
extracted.description: Serve these halloumi and beetroot fritters with a rocket salad for a speedy supper. They’re also excellent warmed the next day in a low oven
ingredient_lines: 50g lighter halloumi drained and coarsely grated
150g cooked beetroot drained and coarsely grated
instruction_lines: Combine the halloumi, flour, baking powder, nigella seeds (if using) and lemon zest in a large bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk together the garlic, egg and milk with a large pinch of fine sea salt and season well with black pepper. Add to the halloumi mixture along with the grated beetroot and mix well.

Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Spoon in 2 heaped tbsp of the batter (you should have enough for six fritters) and level them to about 2cm thick. Fry, in batches, for 3 mins on each side, until golden and cooked through. Mix the lemon juice with the remaining oil and honey in a bowl and season to taste. Toss the rocket with the dressing and serve with the fritters. Will keep chilled for up to three days.
